mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals economic weakness and potential policy intervention, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand weakness, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 300 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL>300 and FEDFUNDS>5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100 base) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO<100 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signals housing market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST<1400 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate severe labor market deterioration, causing risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint behavior of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise does not produce negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 310 signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL>310 over any 3-year rolling window.
